tools.name: load_sb3
tools.title: Load SB3 project
tools.description: Open an existing Scratch 3 / TurboWarp .sb3 file and make it the active project. The file is parsed and validated with TurboWarp's scratch-parser fork; assets are kept in memory for later export. This replaces any currently loaded project, so it is a destructive operation. Only SB3 (projectVersion 3) is supported; export SB2/SB1 projects as SB3 in TurboWarp Desktop first. Returns a project overview and any missing asset references.

path.description: Path to an SB3 file. Relative paths are resolved inside TW_MCP_WORKSPACE; absolute paths must also be inside it unless --allow-any-path is set. Windows paths with backslashes are accepted.

confirm.description: Required when the configured confirmation policy gates this tool. Replaces the active project, so confirmation is recommended.

tools.name: new_project
tools.title: Create a new project
tools.description: Create a new, empty Scratch 3 project in memory and make it the active project. A white 480x360 SVG backdrop and (by default) a Sprite1 with a built-in SVG costume are added. No files are written until export_sb3 is called. This replaces any currently loaded project, so it is a destructive operation. Returns a project overview.

with_default_sprite.description: Create a default Sprite1 with a built-in SVG costume. Defaults to true.

confirm.description: Required when the confirmation policy gates this tool. Creating a project replaces the active project.

tools.name: list_sprites
tools.title: List sprites and Stage
tools.description: List every target in the active project with position, size, direction, costume/sound names, block and script counts, and variable/list counts. This is a read-only tool and never changes the project. Use get_scripts to inspect the actual block stacks for a target.

include_stage.description: Include the Stage entry in the response. Defaults to true. The Stage is never counted as a sprite.

tools.name: add_sprite
tools.title: Add a sprite
tools.description: Add a new sprite to the active project. The sprite gets a PNG or SVG costume (or a built-in SVG costume when costume_path is omitted), a new top layer order, and standard Scratch sprite properties. Sprite names must be unique (case-insensitive). This mutates the active project; call export_sb3 to write it to disk. Returns the new sprite's properties and costume list.

name.description: Unique sprite name. Cannot be "Stage" or "_stage_", and is compared case-insensitively with existing target names.

costume_path.description: Optional path to a PNG or SVG costume. Relative paths resolve inside TW_MCP_WORKSPACE. If omitted, a built-in SVG sprite costume is used.

costume_name.description: Costume name. Defaults to the costume file basename, or "costume1" for the built-in costume.

direction.description: Initial direction in degrees. Defaults to 90.

draggable.description: Whether the sprite can be dragged in the editor. Defaults to false.

rotation_style.description: Initial rotation style. Defaults to "all around".

confirm.description: Required when the confirmation policy gates this tool.

tools.name: add_block
tools.title: Add a block
tools.description: Insert one Scratch 3 block into the active project's Stage or a sprite, either as a new script or attached to an existing script. Built-in defaults and menu shadows are created for known opcodes. Nested reporters, variables, lists, broadcasts, and C-block substacks are supported. Use get_scripts to inspect block ids before appending, inserting, or extending a substack. Unknown extension opcodes are allowed but produce a warning; provide raw inputs when the default metadata is insufficient. This mutates the active project; export_sb3 writes it to disk.

opcode.description: Block opcode or friendly alias, for example "looks_say", "control_repeat", or "say". Unknown opcodes are accepted with a warning; pass raw inputs for them.

target.description: Target name that receives the block. Defaults to the first sprite, or the Stage when no sprites exist.

inputs.description: Input map. Values may be literals, {"variable":"score"}, {"list":"items"}, {"broadcast":"start"}, {"menu":"Sprite2"} (uses the documented menu), {"menu":"costume1","opcode":"looks_costume"}, a nested {"block":{...}} reporter, or {"raw":[1,[10,"text"]]}.

fields.description: Field map. Values may be literals or {"variable":"score"}, {"list":"items"}, {"broadcast":"start"}. Raw Scratch field tuples such as ["name","id"] are also accepted.

substacks.description: Substack map, for example {"SUBSTACK":[...blocks...], "SUBSTACK2":[...]} for control_if_else. Each entry is a chain of block spec objects. Nested values use the same shape as this tool's arguments (opcode/inputs/fields/substacks/mutation).

mutation.description: Raw SB3 mutation object for custom blocks and unusual extension blocks. Passed through unchanged.

mode.description: new = new top-level script; append = after the last block of the anchor script; after = immediately after block_id; start = immediately before block_id; substack = add inside a C-block substack.

block_id.description: Anchor block id for modes "append", "after", "start", and "substack". Use get_scripts to find ids.

substack.description: Substack input name for mode "substack". Defaults to "SUBSTACK"; control_if_else also has "SUBSTACK2".

position.description: Where to insert inside a substack: "start" or "end". Defaults to "end".

x.description: Script x position for a new top-level script.

y.description: Script y position for a new top-level script.

confirm.description: Required when the confirmation policy gates this tool.

tools.name: get_scripts
tools.title: Read scripts
tools.description: Read the scripts of the active project as a structured AST plus a compact text rendering. Each block includes its id, opcode, fields, inputs, mutation, and nested reporter/substack structure. Use block ids from this tool with add_block modes after/start/append/substack. Set target to inspect one Stage/sprite, or omit it to read every target (optionally excluding the Stage). This is a read-only tool.

target.description: Target name (Stage or a sprite). When omitted, scripts from every target are returned.

include_stage.description: When target is omitted, include the Stage. Defaults to true. Ignored when target is set.

max_blocks.description: Maximum number of blocks to parse across all returned targets. Defaults to 2000. Increase only when needed; the response can become very large.

tools.name: set_variable
tools.title: Set a variable
tools.description: Set the value of a Scratch variable in the active project, optionally creating it. Scratch scoping is respected: sprite-local variables shadow global variables, and the Stage owns global variables. Use scope=local with a target to keep a variable private to a sprite, or scope=global to force the Stage's variable. This changes the in-memory project only; export_sb3 writes it to disk.

name.description: Variable name. Lookup is exact first, then case-insensitive when unambiguous.

value.description: New value: a string, finite number, boolean, or null. Arrays/objects are not variable values.

target.description: Target name used for scope resolution. With scope=auto, a local variable on this target shadows a global one. Omit to update a unique variable anywhere.

scope.description: auto = target-local first, then Stage-global; global = only the Stage's variable; local = only the target's variable (target required).

create.description: Create the variable when it does not exist. New variables are global on the Stage unless target+local is requested. Defaults to true.

confirm.description: Required when the confirmation policy gates this tool.

tools.name: get_variable
tools.title: Read a variable
tools.description: Read a Scratch variable from the active project, including its id, scope, owner target, cloud flag, and current value. Scratch scoping is respected: sprite-local variables shadow global ones for that sprite. Returns found=false instead of an error when the variable does not exist. This is a read-only tool.

name.description: Variable name. Exact match wins; otherwise a unique case-insensitive match is accepted.

target.description: Target name used for scope resolution. With scope=auto, a local variable on this target shadows a global one. Omit to search globally and then uniquely across sprites.

scope.description: auto = target-local first, then Stage-global; global = only the Stage's variable; local = only the target's variable (target required).

tools.name: export_sb3
tools.title: Export SB3 project
tools.description: Serialize the active project to a valid SB3 ZIP archive, preserving original assets. Refuses to export when a costume/sound reference has no asset bytes unless allow_missing_assets=true. If no path is given, overwrites the loaded source file or writes <workspace>/<project>.sb3 for a new project. Parent directories are created as needed. This writes to the filesystem and marks the in-memory project as saved.

path.description: Destination .sb3 path. Relative paths resolve inside TW_MCP_WORKSPACE. If omitted, overwrites the loaded source file, or writes <workspace>/<project name>.sb3 for a new project.

pretty.description: Pretty-print project.json inside the archive. Larger but easier to inspect. Defaults to false.

allow_missing_assets.description: Export even when costume/sound references have no bytes in the archive. Defaults to false because TurboWarp may fail to load such a project.

confirm.description: Required when the confirmation policy gates this tool.

tools.name: run_headless
tools.title: Run project headlessly
tools.description: Run an SB3 project with scratch-vm in Node (no renderer, audio, camera, or video). Triggers the green flag, captures say/think events, variable and list snapshots, and monitor values, then stops the VM. Use this to smoke-test logic, not to validate visuals or sound. TurboWarp-only extensions, custom extensions, cloud variables, camera/video, microphone, and platform-specific blocks are not available. Forever loops run until duration_ms; stop_when_idle ends ordinary scripts early.

path.description: SB3 file to run. When omitted, the active in-memory project is serialized and run. Relative paths resolve inside TW_MCP_WORKSPACE.

duration_ms.description: Maximum wall-clock run time in milliseconds. Defaults to 3000; maximum 120000.

turbo.description: Enable scratch-vm turbo mode so loops run without frame pacing. Defaults to true.

stop_when_idle.description: Stop early once all scripts have finished and no threads remain. Defaults to true. Forever loops still run until duration_ms.

confirm.description: Executes project code. Required when TW_MCP_CONFIRM=all; optional under the default "destructive" policy.

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.title: List known block opcodes
tools.description: List the built-in block registry used by add_block: opcodes, shapes, categories, input names, field names/defaults/options, substacks, aliases, and TurboWarp-only flags. The registry covers the standard Scratch 3 categories plus common TurboWarp blocks, but it is not exhaustive. Unknown extension opcodes can still be inserted with add_block and raw inputs. This is a read-only tool.

category.description: Only return blocks from this category.

turbo_warp_only.description: When true, return only blocks marked as TurboWarp-specific. Defaults to false (all blocks).
